content.about: The Federated States of Micronesia is a nation of over 600 islands in the western Pacific. It has four states. Nan Madol is an ancient stone city. Yap has huge stone money.

standout.text: Nan Madol is a ruined city built on artificial islets.

didYouKnow: Yap uses giant stone discs as money.
Nan Madol is built on reefs.
